en-US.title: OpnShelf
en-US.subtitle: Track films, shows & books
en-US.description:
OpnShelf is a personal media tracker built on the AT Protocol. Log what you watch, rate and review it, and keep a shelf you actually own — your data lives in your own repository, not locked inside ours.

- Search films and TV shows
- Log watches with the date you watched
- Rate with stars and write full reviews
- Build a shelf of everything you track
- Sign in with your AT Protocol / Bluesky account

OpnShelf is open and portable: your reviews are standard.site documents in your own PDS, so they travel with you across the network.
